column2:
eagle(n.)老鷹
(無詞性變化)
bald eagle 白頭鷹
eagle eye 銳利的眼光
An eagle flew high above the mountain.
(一隻老鷹在山的上空高飛。)
The bald eagle is a symbol of the United States.
(白頭鷹是美國的象徵。)

earn(v.)賺取、贏得
earnings(n.)收入、所得
earn money 賺錢
earn a living 謀生
She earns money by teaching piano.
(她靠教鋼琴賺錢。)
He earned the respect of his classmates.
(他贏得了同學們的尊敬。)

earring(n.)耳環、earrings(n.)一對耳環
(無詞性變化)
a pair of earrings 一對耳環
gold earrings 金耳環
She wore a pair of silver earrings.
(她戴了一對銀耳環。)
I lost one of my earrings at the party.
(我在派對上弄丟了一隻耳環。)

earthquake(n.)地震
(無詞性變化)
strong earthquake 強烈地震
earthquake drill 地震演習
Taiwan has many earthquakes every year.
(台灣每年都有許多地震。)
Our school held an earthquake drill today.
(我們學校今天舉行了地震演習。)

ease(n./v.)容易、舒適、減輕
easy(adj.)容易的
easily(adv.)容易地
with ease 輕鬆地
at ease 自在、放鬆
She passed the test with ease.
(她輕鬆地通過了考試。)
This medicine will ease the pain.
(這種藥可以減輕疼痛。)

eastern(adj.)東方的、東部的
east(n.)東方
eastern Taiwan 東台灣
Eastern culture 東方文化
Hualien is a city in eastern Taiwan.
(花蓮是東台灣的一個城市。)
He is interested in Eastern culture.
(他對東方文化很有興趣。)

edge(n./v.)邊緣、優勢、側身移動
edgy(adj.)緊張不安的
on the edge of 在…的邊緣
have an edge over 比…佔優勢
Don't stand too close to the edge of the cliff.
(不要站得離懸崖邊緣太近。)
Her English skills give her an edge over others.
(她的英文能力讓她比別人更有優勢。)

edition(n.)版本、版次
edit(v.)編輯
editor(n.)編輯
first edition 初版
limited edition 限量版
This is the first edition of the book.
(這是這本書的初版。)
He bought a limited edition of the sneakers.
(他買了一雙限量版的運動鞋。)

education(n.)教育
educate(v.)教育
educational(adj.)教育的
higher education 高等教育
receive an education 接受教育
Education is the key to a better future.
(教育是通往更好未來的關鍵。)
Every child should receive a good education.
(每個孩子都應該受到良好的教育。)

effect(n./v.)影響、效果、產生
effective(adj.)有效的
have an effect on 對…有影響
side effect 副作用
Music has a strong effect on our mood.
(音樂對我們的心情有很大的影響。)
This medicine has no side effects.
(這種藥沒有副作用。)

effective(adj.)有效的、生效的
effect(n.)效果
effectively(adv.)有效地
effective way 有效的方法
highly effective 非常有效
Exercise is an effective way to lose weight.
(運動是減重的有效方法。)
The new rule becomes effective next month.
(新規定下個月生效。)

effort(n.)努力、費力
effortless(adj.)不費力的
make an effort 努力
a waste of effort 白費力氣
She made a great effort to win the race.
(她為了贏得比賽付出極大的努力。)
Learning English takes time and effort.
(學英文需要時間和努力。)

elder(n./adj.)長輩、年長的
elderly(adj.)年長的
elder brother 哥哥
respect your elders 尊敬長輩
My elder sister studies in Taichung.
(我姊姊在台中讀書。)
We should respect our elders.
(我們應該尊敬長輩。)

electric(adj.)電的、電動的
electricity(n.)電、電力
electric car 電動車
electric fan 電風扇
More people are driving electric cars now.
(現在越來越多人開電動車。)
Please turn off the electric fan.
(請把電風扇關掉。)

electrical(adj.)電的、與電有關的
electrician(n.)電工
electrical engineer 電機工程師
electrical problem 電路問題
My uncle is an electrical engineer.
(我叔叔是一名電機工程師。)
The fire was caused by an electrical problem.
(那場火災是電路問題引起的。)

emotion(n.)情緒、情感
emotional(adj.)情緒的、激動的
show emotion 表露情感
control one's emotions 控制情緒
He tried hard to control his emotions.
(他努力控制自己的情緒。)
Her voice was full of emotion.
(她的聲音充滿了情感。)

emphasize(v.)強調
emphasis(n.)強調、重點
emphasize the importance 強調重要性
strongly emphasize 特別強調
The teacher emphasized the importance of reading.
(老師強調閱讀的重要性。)
Our coach always emphasizes teamwork.
(我們教練總是強調團隊合作。)

employ(v.)雇用、使用、employment(n.)雇用、就業
employee(n.)員工
employer(n.)雇主
employ workers 雇用員工
full-time employment 全職工作
The factory employs over 500 workers.
(這家工廠雇用了五百多名員工。)
It is hard to find employment in this area.
(在這個地區很難找到工作。)

employee(n.)員工、受雇者
employ(v.)雇用
employer(n.)雇主
full-time employee 全職員工
new employee 新進員工
The company has about 200 employees.
(這家公司大約有兩百名員工。)
The new employee started work on Monday.
(新進員工星期一開始上班。)

employer(n.)雇主、老闆
employ(v.)雇用
employee(n.)員工
good employer 好雇主
former employer 前雇主
My employer gave me a day off.
(我的老闆給了我一天假。)
She asked her former employer for a letter.
(她請前雇主幫她寫一封推薦信。)

empty(adj./v.)空的、倒空
emptiness(n.)空虛
empty bottle 空瓶
empty the trash 倒垃圾
The classroom was empty after school.
(放學後教室空無一人。)
Could you empty the trash can?
(你可以把垃圾桶倒乾淨嗎？)

encourage(v.)鼓勵、encouragement(n.)鼓勵
encouraging(adj.)令人鼓舞的
encourage sb. to 鼓勵某人去
words of encouragement 鼓勵的話
My teacher encouraged me to join the contest.
(老師鼓勵我參加比賽。)
Thank you for your encouragement.
(謝謝你的鼓勵。)

ending(n.)結局、結尾
end(n./v.)結束
happy ending 快樂的結局
surprise ending 出人意料的結局
I like movies with happy endings.
(我喜歡有快樂結局的電影。)
The story has a surprise ending.
(這個故事有一個出人意料的結局。)

enemy(n.)敵人
(無詞性變化)
make enemies 樹敵
natural enemy 天敵
Cats are natural enemies of mice.
(貓是老鼠的天敵。)
He is kind and has no enemies.
(他很和善，沒有任何敵人。)

energy(n.)精力、能源、能量
energetic(adj.)精力充沛的
full of energy 充滿活力
solar energy 太陽能
The kids are full of energy.
(孩子們精力充沛。)
Solar energy is clean and safe.
(太陽能乾淨又安全。)

engine(n.)引擎、發動機
engineer(n.)工程師
start the engine 發動引擎
search engine 搜尋引擎
He started the engine and drove away.
(他發動引擎後開車離去。)
Google is a popular search engine.
(Google 是一個很受歡迎的搜尋引擎。)

entire(adj.)全部的、整個的
entirely(adv.)完全地
the entire class 全班
entire day 一整天
The entire class passed the test.
(全班都通過了考試。)
I spent the entire day at home.
(我一整天都待在家。)

entrance(n.)入口、進入、入學
enter(v.)進入
main entrance 正門
entrance exam 入學考試
Let's meet at the main entrance.
(我們在正門碰面吧。)
She is preparing for the entrance exam.
(她正在準備入學考試。)

environment(n.)環境
environmental(adj.)環境的
protect the environment 保護環境
learning environment 學習環境
We should protect the environment.
(我們應該保護環境。)
The school offers a good learning environment.
(這所學校提供良好的學習環境。)

environmental(adj.)環境的
environment(n.)環境
environmentally(adv.)環境上
environmental protection 環境保護
environmental problem 環境問題
Air pollution is a serious environmental problem.
(空氣汙染是嚴重的環境問題。)
She works for an environmental group.
(她在一個環保團體工作。)

equal(adj./v./n.)相等的、平等的、等於、同等的人
equality(n.)平等
equally(adv.)平等地
equal rights 平等權利
be equal to 等於
Two plus three equals five.
(二加三等於五。)
Men and women should have equal rights.
(男女應享有平等的權利。)

escape(v./n.)逃脫、逃避、逃跑
(無詞性變化)
escape from 從…逃出
narrow escape 九死一生
The bird escaped from its cage.
(那隻鳥從籠子裡逃了出來。)
They had a narrow escape in the fire.
(他們在火災中死裡逃生。)

especially(adv.)特別、尤其
especial(adj.)特別的
especially for 特別為了
especially when 尤其是當
I love fruit, especially mangoes.
(我愛水果，尤其是芒果。)
This gift is especially for you.
(這份禮物是特別為你準備的。)

essay(n.)論說文、散文、短文
essayist(n.)散文家
write an essay 寫文章
essay question 申論題
We have to write an essay about our hometown.
(我們必須寫一篇關於家鄉的文章。)
The essay question was the hardest part.
(申論題是最難的部分。)

eve(n.)前夕、前一天
(無詞性變化)
Christmas Eve 聖誕夜
New Year's Eve 跨年夜
We had a big dinner on Christmas Eve.
(我們在聖誕夜吃了一頓大餐。)
Where will you spend New Year's Eve?
(你要在哪裡跨年？)

event(n.)事件、活動、比賽項目
eventful(adj.)多事的
sports event 運動賽事
school event 學校活動
The school sports event is next Friday.
(學校運動會在下週五舉行。)
Her wedding was a big event in the village.
(她的婚禮是村裡的一件大事。)

evil(n./adj.)邪惡、罪惡、邪惡的
(無詞性變化)
good and evil 善與惡
evil spirit 惡靈
The story is about good and evil.
(這個故事是關於善與惡的。)
The evil witch wanted to hurt the princess.
(邪惡的巫婆想要傷害公主。)

exact(adj.)確切的、精確的
exactly(adv.)確切地、正是
exact time 確切的時間
exact same 完全相同的
What is the exact time now?
(現在確切的時間是幾點？)
We wore the exact same shirt today.
(我們今天穿了一模一樣的上衣。)

examination(n.)考試、檢查
exam(n.)考試(口語)
examine(v.)檢查、測驗
final exam 期末考
medical examination 健康檢查
I have to study for the final exam.
(我得為期末考讀書。)
All new students need a medical examination.
(所有新生都需要做健康檢查。)

examine(v.)檢查、審查、測驗
examination(n.)檢查、考試
examiner(n.)主考官
examine carefully 仔細檢查
examine a patient 為病人看診
The doctor examined my throat.
(醫生檢查了我的喉嚨。)
Please examine the report carefully.
(請仔細檢查這份報告。)

excite(v.)使興奮、excitement(n.)興奮、刺激
excited(adj.)興奮的
exciting(adj.)令人興奮的
get excited 變得興奮
in excitement 興奮地
The kids got excited about the trip.
(孩子們對這次旅行感到很興奮。)
She jumped up and down in excitement.
(她興奮地跳上跳下。)

excuse(v./n.)原諒、藉口
(無詞性變化)
excuse me 對不起、打擾一下
make an excuse 找藉口
Excuse me, where is the library?
(打擾一下，請問圖書館在哪裡？)
Stop making excuses for being late.
(別再為遲到找藉口了。)

exist(v.)存在、生存
existence(n.)存在
existing(adj.)現有的
still exist 仍然存在
cannot exist without 沒有…就無法生存
Do you think ghosts really exist?
(你覺得鬼真的存在嗎？)
Fish cannot exist without water.
(魚沒有水就無法生存。)

existence(n.)存在、生存
exist(v.)存在
come into existence 開始存在、產生
the existence of 存在著…
Scientists question the existence of life on Mars.
(科學家質疑火星上是否有生命存在。)
The company came into existence in 1990.
(這家公司成立於 1990 年。)

exit(n./v.)出口、離開
(無詞性變化)
emergency exit 緊急出口
exit the room 離開房間
Please use the emergency exit in a fire.
(火災時請走緊急出口。)
He quietly exited the room.
(他悄悄地離開了房間。)

expense(n.)費用、支出
expensive(adj.)昂貴的
living expenses 生活費
at the expense of 以…為代價
My living expenses are high in Taipei.
(我在台北的生活費很高。)
He worked hard at the expense of his health.
(他犧牲健康拼命工作。)

expert(n./adj.)專家、熟練的
expertise(n.)專業知識
expert in 在…方面的專家
expert advice 專家建議
She is an expert in computer science.
(她是電腦科學的專家。)
You should ask for expert advice.
(你應該尋求專家的建議。)

express(v./adj./adv./n.)表達、快速的、以快遞、快車
expression(n.)表達、表情
expressive(adj.)富表現力的
express oneself 表達自己
express train 快車
It's hard for me to express my feelings.
(要表達我的感受對我來說很難。)
We took the express train to Kaohsiung.
(我們搭快車去高雄。)

expression(n.)表達、表情、措辭
express(v.)表達
facial expression 臉部表情
freedom of expression 言論自由
Her facial expression showed she was angry.
(她的臉部表情顯示她很生氣。)
Learn this expression and use it often.
(學會這個說法並且常常使用它。)

extra(adj./adv./n.)額外的、特別地、額外的東西
(無詞性變化)
extra money 額外的錢
extra charge 額外收費
Can I have an extra blanket?
(我可以多要一條毯子嗎？)
There is no extra charge for drinks.
(飲料不另外收費。)

eyebrow(n.)眉毛
brow(n.)眉毛、額頭
raise an eyebrow 揚起眉毛(表示驚訝)
thick eyebrows 濃眉
He has thick black eyebrows.
(他有濃黑的眉毛。)
She raised an eyebrow when she heard the news.
(她聽到這個消息時揚起了眉毛。)

factor(n.)因素、要素
(無詞性變化)
key factor 關鍵因素
important factor 重要因素
Hard work is a key factor in success.
(努力是成功的關鍵因素。)
Price is an important factor when shopping.
(購物時價格是一個重要因素。)

failure(n.)失敗、失敗者、故障
fail(v.)失敗
end in failure 以失敗告終
power failure 停電
Failure is the mother of success.
(失敗為成功之母。)
The plan ended in failure.
(這個計畫以失敗告終。)

fair(adj./n./adv.)公平的、晴朗的、博覽會、公平地
fairly(adv.)相當、公平地
fairness(n.)公平
fair play 公平競爭
book fair 書展
That's not fair to the other players.
(那樣對其他選手不公平。)
We went to the book fair last weekend.
(我們上週末去了書展。)

false(adj.)錯誤的、假的
falsely(adv.)錯誤地
true or false 是非題
false teeth 假牙
Is this sentence true or false?
(這個句子是對還是錯？)
He gave the police false information.
(他給警方提供了錯誤的資訊。)

fashion(n./v.)時尚、流行、方式、塑造
fashionable(adj.)流行的、時髦的
in fashion 流行
fashion show 時裝秀
Short hair is in fashion this year.
(今年流行短髮。)
She wants to be a fashion designer.
(她想成為服裝設計師。)

fate(n.)命運
fatal(adj.)致命的
by fate 命中注定
accept one's fate 接受命運
It was fate that we met again.
(我們再次相遇是命中注定。)
He refused to accept his fate.
(他拒絕接受自己的命運。)

fault(n./v.)錯誤、過錯、缺點、挑剔
faulty(adj.)有缺陷的
my fault 我的錯
find fault with 挑剔
It's not your fault.
(這不是你的錯。)
My boss always finds fault with my work.
(我老闆總是挑剔我的工作。)

favor(n./v.)恩惠、幫忙、偏愛、支持
favorable(adj.)有利的、贊同的
do sb. a favor 幫某人一個忙
in favor of 支持、贊成
Could you do me a favor?
(你可以幫我一個忙嗎？)
Most students are in favor of the plan.
(大部分學生都支持這個計畫。)

favorite(adj./n.)最喜愛的、最喜愛的人事物
favor(v.)偏愛
favorite food 最喜歡的食物
all-time favorite 一直以來的最愛
Pizza is my favorite food.
(披薩是我最喜歡的食物。)
This song is my all-time favorite.
(這首歌是我一直以來的最愛。)

fear(n./v.)恐懼、害怕
fearful(adj.)害怕的
fearless(adj.)無畏的
in fear 恐懼地
fear of heights 懼高症
She has a fear of heights.
(她有懼高症。)
The boy shook in fear.
(那男孩害怕得發抖。)

feature(n./v.)特色、特徵、五官、以…為特色
(無詞性變化)
main feature 主要特色
special feature 特點
The phone has many new features.
(這支手機有許多新功能。)
The show features young singers.
(這個節目以年輕歌手為主打。)

fee(n.)費用、酬勞
(無詞性變化)
school fees 學費
entrance fee 入場費
The entrance fee is 100 dollars.
(入場費是一百元。)
Parents pay school fees every term.
(家長每學期要繳學費。)

feeling(n.)感覺、感情、感受
feel(v.)感覺
hurt one's feelings 傷害某人的感情
have a feeling 有預感
I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
(我不是故意要傷害你的感情。)
I have a feeling he won't come.
(我有預感他不會來。)

fellow(n.)傢伙、夥伴、同伴
fellowship(n.)夥伴關係、交情
fellow students 同學
nice fellow 好人
He is a nice fellow.
(他是個好人。)
She gets along well with her fellow students.
(她和同學們相處得很好。)

female(adj./n.)女性的、雌性的、女性
(無詞性變化)
female student 女學生
female animal 雌性動物
Our class has twenty female students.
(我們班有二十個女學生。)
The female bird is sitting on the eggs.
(那隻母鳥正在孵蛋。)

fever(n.)發燒、狂熱
feverish(adj.)發燒的
have a fever 發燒
high fever 高燒
She stayed home because she had a fever.
(她因為發燒待在家裡。)
The baby has a high fever.
(那個嬰兒發高燒。)

field(n.)田野、場地、領域
(無詞性變化)
rice field 稻田
field trip 校外教學
We went on a field trip to the zoo.
(我們去動物園校外教學。)
He is an expert in the field of science.
(他是科學領域的專家。)

figure(n./v.)數字、身材、人物、認為
(無詞性變化)
figure out 想出、理解
keep one's figure 保持身材
I can't figure out this math problem.
(我想不出這道數學題。)
He is an important figure in history.
(他是歷史上的重要人物。)

final(adj./n.)最後的、決賽、期末考
finally(adv.)最後、終於
final exam 期末考
make the final 打進決賽
This is the final chapter of the book.
(這是這本書的最後一章。)
Our team made it to the final.
(我們隊打進了決賽。)

fireman(n.)消防員
firewoman(n.)女消防員
firefighter(n.)消防員
brave fireman 英勇的消防員

(那位消防員從火場中救出一個小孩。)

(我阿姨是台北的女消防員。)

firm(n./adj./v./adv.)公司、堅定的、穩固的、使堅固

firm decision 堅定的決定
My father works for a law firm.
(我爸爸在一家律師事務所工作。)

(她緊緊握住我的手。)

fisherman(n.)漁夫
fish(v.)釣魚、捕魚

(許多漁夫住在這個小鎮上。)

fit(v./adj./n./adv.)適合、合身、健康的、合身

keep fit 保持健康
fit in 融入

(這雙鞋我穿不合腳。)

(我慢跑來保持健康。)

fix(v./n.)修理、固定、安排
fixed(adj.)固定的
fix a bike 修腳踏車
fix a time 定下時間
My dad can fix almost anything.
(我爸爸幾乎什麼都會修。)

(我們來定個開會時間吧。)

flag(n.)旗子、旗幟

(每個國家都有自己的國旗。)

lie flat 平躺

(人們曾經以為地球是平的。)

flight(n.)飛行、班機、航班

(她想當空服員。)

(警察管制車流。)

flu(n.)流行性感冒

focus(n./v.)焦點、重點、集中

folk(n.)人們、民族、家人

football(n.)美式足球、足球(英式)

forest(n.)森林

form(n./v.)形式、表格、形成
